Description
The Valcambi 1 kilo gold bar has always been one of the most popular sizes of gold bar. The
Valcambi Suisse
produces these gold bars which were established in
Balerna(Switzerland)
in 1961. The refinery was initially known as Valori and Cambu. Since the merger of Credit Suisse, the name Valcambi Suisse has been used for a number of decades. Valcambi Suisse  bars of gold such as these 1 kilo Gold bars, have flat surfaces, defined edges, and rounded edges. They are perfect for stacking due to their shape.
The 1 kilo Valcambi Gold bars are a mark of exceptional quality, with a guarantee of .9999 purity and high liquidity. These
gold bars
have a remarkable heft. It is the perfect choice for anyone who enjoys handling and feeling their
gold bullion
. You are not only getting a valuable precious metal, fabricated by Swiss engineering excellence, but also alternative hard money that is guaranteed to be internationally accepted by bullion traders, financial institutions, and investors alike.
Design of Valcambi Suisse Gold Bar 1 kilo
The Valcambi Suisse Gold Bar 1 kilo obverse side features all of the markings. This side features the Valcambi Suisse logo as well as the refinery’s name. The logo is a square containing a throwing star-like feature at the center. You can find inscriptions that represent the bar’s weight and purity as well on this side. There is also an individual serial number and an assayers stamp and all of the engravings are arranged in horizontal order from the left to the right of the bar. These bars use a five-number, two-letter coding system to assign serial numbers.
The reverse side of this 1 kilo Valcambi gold bar is intentionally left blank.
Main Highlights of 1 Kilo Valcambi Gold Bar
Contains 1 kilo (32.15 troy oz) of .9999 fine gold.
Produced by the Valcambi Suisse
Eligible for Precious Metal IRAs.
Arrives in protective plastic packaging.
The obverse features the depiction of the mint logo, name, purity, weight, assayers marks, and serial number.
The reverse is left blank with no markings.
Features the individual unique serial number.
